questions.stem: The resting membrane potential (RMP) of a cardiac myocyte is approximately:
questions.answerText: -90 mV

options.C: K+ efflux via inward rectifying channels

questions.answerText: K+ efflux via inward rectifying channels
questions.rawBlockText: 2. The main ion responsible for the resting membrane potential in cardiac myocytes is: A) Na+ influx B) Ca++ influx C) K+ efflux via inward rectifying channels D) Cl- efflux Correct Answer: C) K+ efflux via inward rectifying channels

questions.stem: The Na+-K+ ATPase pump is described as electrogenic because it:

options.A: Pumps 2 Na+ out for each 3 K+ in
options.B: Pumps 3 Na+ out for each 2 K+ in
options.C: Pumps equal amounts of Na+ and K+

questions.answerText: Pumps 3 Na+ out for each 2 K+ in
questions.rawBlockText: 3. The Na+-K+ ATPase pump is described as electrogenic because it: A) Pumps 2 Na+ out for each 3 K+ in B) Pumps 3 Na+ out for each 2 K+ in C) Pumps equal amounts of Na+ and K+ D) Only works during action potentials Correct Answer: B) Pumps 3 Na+ out for each 2 K+ in

questions.stem: Which structure has the fastest rate of spontaneous depolarization in the cardiac conduction system?
